import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
theorem is_bst_node (v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) :
    is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) ↔
      ((∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧ is_bst r) := by
  simp only [is_bst]

def join : BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, r => r
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr, r => BinarySearchTree.Node x ll (join lr r)

def del : BinarySearchTree → Int → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, _ => BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x l r, v =>
      if v < x then BinarySearchTree.Node x (del l v) r
      else if x < v then BinarySearchTree.Node x l (del r v)
      else join l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  del t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : delete_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_join (l r : BinarySearchTree) : view (join l r) = view l ∪ view r := by
  induction l with
  | Empty => simp [join, view]
  | Node x ll lr ihll ihlr =>
    have hj : join (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) r
        = BinarySearchTree.Node x ll (join lr r) := by simp [join]
    rw [hj]
    simp only [view, ihlr]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto

theorem bst_join : ∀ (l r : BinarySearchTree), is_bst l → is_bst r →
    (∀ a ∈ view l, ∀ b ∈ view r, a < b) → is_bst (join l r) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | Empty =>
    intro r _ hr _
    simpa [join] using hr
  | Node x ll lr ihll ihlr =>
    intro r h hr hlt
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    have hj : join (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) r
        = BinarySearchTree.Node x ll (join lr r) := by simp [join]
    rw [hj, is_bst_node]
    refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      rw [view_join, Set.mem_union] at hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact h3 y hy
      · have hx : x ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) := by
          simp [view]
        exact hlt x hx y hy
    · refine ihlr r h4 hr ?_
      intro a ha b hb
      refine hlt a ?_ b hb
      simp only [view, Set.mem_union]
      tauto

theorem view_del : ∀ (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int), is_bst t →
    view (del t v) = view t \ {v} := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
    intro v _
    simp [del, view]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro v h
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨hl_lt, hl, hr_gt, hr⟩ := h
    by_cases hc1 : v < x
    · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node x (del l v) r := by simp [del, hc1]
      rw [hd]
      simp only [view, ihl v hl]
      ext y
      have k1 : y ∈ view r → y ≠ v := by
        intro hy hyv
        have := hr_gt y hy
        omega
      have k2 : y = x → y ≠ v := by
        intro hy hyv
        omega
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    · by_cases hc2 : x < v
      · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
            = BinarySearchTree.Node x l (del r v) := by simp [del, hc1, hc2]
        rw [hd]
        simp only [view, ihr v hr]
        ext y
        have k1 : y ∈ view l → y ≠ v := by
          intro hy hyv
          have := hl_lt y hy
          omega
        have k2 : y = x → y ≠ v := by
          intro hy hyv
          omega
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto
      · have hvx : v = x := by omega
        rw [hvx]
        have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) x = join l r := by simp [del]
        rw [hd, view_join]
        simp only [view]
        ext y
        have k1 : y ∈ view l → y ≠ x := by
          intro hy hyx
          have := hl_lt y hy
          omega
        have k2 : y ∈ view r → y ≠ x := by
          intro hy hyx
          have := hr_gt y hy
          omega
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto

theorem bst_del : ∀ (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int), is_bst t → is_bst (del t v) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
    intro v _
    simp [del, is_bst]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro v h
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨hl_lt, hl, hr_gt, hr⟩ := h
    by_cases hc1 : v < x
    · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node x (del l v) r := by simp [del, hc1]
      rw [hd, is_bst_node]
      refine ⟨?_, ihl v hl, hr_gt, hr⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [view_del l v hl] at hy
      exact hl_lt y hy.1
    · by_cases hc2 : x < v
      · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
            = BinarySearchTree.Node x l (del r v) := by simp [del, hc1, hc2]
        rw [hd, is_bst_node]
        refine ⟨hl_lt, hl, ?_, ihr v hr⟩
        intro y hy
        rw [view_del r v hr] at hy
        exact hr_gt y hy.1
      · have hvx : v = x := by omega
        rw [hvx]
        have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) x = join l r := by simp [del]
        rw [hd]
        exact bst_join l r hl hr (fun a ha b hb => lt_trans (hl_lt a ha) (hr_gt b hb))
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) :
    delete_postcond t v (delete t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show is_bst (del t v)
    exact bst_del t v h_precond
  · show view (del t v) = view t \ {v}
    exact view_del t v h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof

- `view_del`: under `is_bst t`, `view (del t v) = view t \ {v}`. In the `v < x` branch, `v` cannot occur in the right subtree (all elements there are `> x > v`) nor be `x`; symmetric for `x < v`; in the equal branch `x ∉ view l` and `x ∉ view r`.
- `bst_del`: BST is preserved; the equal branch uses `bst_join` with `a < x < b`, the others use `view (del s v) ⊆ view s` (from `view_del`).

The final postcondition is the conjunction of `bst_del` and `view_del`.

import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
theorem is_bst_node (v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) :
    is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) ↔
      ((∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧ is_bst r) := by
  simp only [is_bst]

def join : BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, r => r
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr, r => BinarySearchTree.Node x ll (join lr r)

def del : BinarySearchTree → Int → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, _ => BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x l r, v =>
      if v < x then BinarySearchTree.Node x (del l v) r
      else if x < v then BinarySearchTree.Node x l (del r v)
      else join l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  del t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : delete_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_join (l r : BinarySearchTree) : view (join l r) = view l ∪ view r := by
  induction l with
  | Empty => simp [join, view]
  | Node x ll lr ihll ihlr =>
    have hj : join (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) r
        = BinarySearchTree.Node x ll (join lr r) := by simp [join]
    rw [hj]
    simp only [view, ihlr]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto

theorem bst_join : ∀ (l r : BinarySearchTree), is_bst l → is_bst r →
    (∀ a ∈ view l, ∀ b ∈ view r, a < b) → is_bst (join l r) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | Empty =>
    intro r _ hr _
    simpa [join] using hr
  | Node x ll lr ihll ihlr =>
    intro r h hr hlt
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    have hj : join (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) r
        = BinarySearchTree.Node x ll (join lr r) := by simp [join]
    rw [hj, is_bst_node]
    refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      rw [view_join, Set.mem_union] at hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact h3 y hy
      · have hx : x ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node x ll lr) := by
          simp [view]
        exact hlt x hx y hy
    · refine ihlr r h4 hr ?_
      intro a ha b hb
      refine hlt a ?_ b hb
      simp only [view, Set.mem_union]
      tauto

theorem view_del : ∀ (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int), is_bst t →
    view (del t v) = view t \ {v} := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
    intro v _
    simp [del, view]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>

    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨hl_lt, hl, hr_gt, hr⟩ := h
    by_cases hc1 : v < x
    · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v

      simp only [view, ihl v hl]
      ext y
      have k1 : y ∈ view r → y ≠ v := by
        intro hy hyv
        have := hr_gt y hy
        omega
      have k2 : y = x → y ≠ v := by
        intro hy hyv
        omega
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    · by_cases hc2 : x < v
      · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
            = BinarySearchTree.Node x l (del r v) := by simp [del, hc1, hc2]
        rw [hd]
        simp only [view, ihr v hr]
        ext y
        have k1 : y ∈ view l → y ≠ v := by
          intro hy hyv
          have := hl_lt y hy
          omega
        have k2 : y = x → y ≠ v := by
          intro hy hyv
          omega
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto
      · have hvx : v = x := by omega
        rw [hvx]
        have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) x = join l r := by simp [del]

        simp only [view]
        ext y
        have k1 : y ∈ view l → y ≠ x := by
          intro hy hyx
          have := hl_lt y hy
          omega
        have k2 : y ∈ view r → y ≠ x := by
          intro hy hyx
          have := hr_gt y hy
          omega
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto

theorem bst_del : ∀ (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int), is_bst t → is_bst (del t v) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
    intro v _
    simp [del, is_bst]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro v h
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨hl_lt, hl, hr_gt, hr⟩ := h
    by_cases hc1 : v < x
    · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
          = BinarySearchTree.Node x (del l v) r := by simp [del, hc1]
      rw [hd, is_bst_node]
      refine ⟨?_, ihl v hl, hr_gt, hr⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [view_del l v hl] at hy
      exact hl_lt y hy.1
    · by_cases hc2 : x < v
      · have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v
            = BinarySearchTree.Node x l (del r v) := by simp [del, hc1, hc2]
        rw [hd, is_bst_node]
        refine ⟨hl_lt, hl, ?_, ihr v hr⟩
        intro y hy
        rw [view_del r v hr] at hy
        exact hr_gt y hy.1
      · have hvx : v = x := by omega
        rw [hvx]
        have hd : del (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) x = join l r := by simp [del]
        rw [hd]
        exact bst_join l r hl hr (fun a ha b hb => lt_trans (hl_lt a ha) (hr_gt b hb))

  · show is_bst (del t v)
